text:
alex: Quick heads-up — NVIDIA pushed a driver rollback on 535.x in us-west yesterday; partners reported a tensor-core perf regression. Tagging @maria for runtime impact.

maria: Saw alerts — our e2e on rtx-6000 pools shows ~8-12% throughput drop for typical chat load (seq 2048). Repro when kernel selector falls back. Investigating fallback path.

jordan: Is this strictly CUDA/driver (535) or does ROCm show anything similar? We need clear pinning guidance for marketplace images and SI integrators.

samir: @jordan initial confirmation: only CUDA drivers so far. ROCm 5.x looks stable. I looped in roshan@hw-partner for vendor confirmation.

nisha: For Dedicated / marketplace images, recommend a quick hotfix: pin driver to 534.86 and force kernel path A until vendor patch. Draft snippet for Dockerfile: 
```bash
# dockerfile snippet for marketplace image
ENV NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION=534.86
RUN /usr/local/bin/check_driver.sh $NVIDIA_DRIVER_VERSION || exit 1
```

alex: +1. Also prepare an air-gapped rollback playbook for Private customers. Short checklist would help.

maria: Checklist (draft):
- notify affected customers via support (template ready)
- push marketplace image with pinned driver tag
- enable canary on 10% traffic for 2h
- monitor token latency and throughput, rollback if >5% regression

jordan: Add a telemetry flag so we can detect kernel-selection fallback easily. Suggest emitting an event like: 
```json
{"event":"kernel_fallback","model":"gpt-4-mini","notes":"driver 535 observed"}
```

samir: Roshan replied: vendor will release 535.1 hotfix next week. Their interim recommendation is to pin to 534.* until hotfix is validated.

nisha: I'll create a Jira (partner-gpu-driver-hotfix) and attach recommended image tags + support message template.

alex: Nice. Can someone draft a short marketplace changelog blurb? Keep it neutral (avoid blaming vendor).

maria: Draft changelog: "Updated GPU runtime image: pinned stable driver 534.86 to address recent performance variability. Customers on auto-update should see improved throughput."

jordan: @deploy-bot can we schedule a rolling publish for marketplace images tomorrow 02:00 UTC?

deploy-bot: scheduled rolling_publish to market/us-west at 2025-04-09T02:00:00Z :white_check_mark:

alex: Thanks — I'll coordinate a partner sync call after the vendor hotfix lands. :calendar:
